The DRC produces 3% of the world's Copper and half its Cobalt, and most all of it is mined in Katanga.

In southern Africa, the DRC's crude oil reserves that are second only to that of Angola's. As of 2009, the DRC's crude oil reserves came to 180 million barrels.

Testing drilling is expected to cost $11 million, a little more than usual because of the poor accessibility of the region and palms that need greasing.
